subject: Mid-quarter trajectory: scope trims, critical dependencies, and QBR deck asks
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia@acme-enterprises.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter trajectory: scope trims, critical dependencies, and QBR deck asks

Team —

Quick mid-quarter pulse and a proposed, narrow re-scope to keep our QBR narrative crisp and credible. We’ll present 3 clear asks to the board: (1) a revised, achievable feature set for Optimize this quarter; (2) confirmation on dedicated capacity procurement for the Search workload; (3) a concise risk table with owners for the QBR deck.

Current signal: delivery velocity on Optimize has slowed (blocked by perf regressions + infra queue). If we don’t trim nonessential heuristics, we risk a slide in quality metrics and a stretch on our latency SLO. Proposal below — please reply inline with owners and ETA. I need confirmations by COB Sep 30 so the QBR deck can be finalized tomorrow.

Proposal (high level)
- Re-scope Optimize to Focus A/B: ship core reranking + caching improvements; postpone nonblocking experiment infra for next quarter.
- Request Dedicated Capacity: 2x T4-equivalent slots reserved for Search peak hours for Oct–Nov (cost estimate attached).
- Risk table: list top 5 risks, mitigation owner, and two-week contingency plan.

Asks and suggested owners
- Infra perf bench & dedicated capacity ops: Vivek + Rohan (deliver perf numbers + capacity runbook by Oct 5).
- Latency SLO check + gating criteria: Karthik (provide pass/fail thresholds and rollback plan).
- Finance signoff owner + cost center: Monica (confirm funding source and timeline).
- QBR deck slide updates and narrative: Laura (I’ll hand the final slide deck to you for polish).

Attachments: QBR-draft-v2.pptx (slide stub), OKR-runbook-2026Q3.xlsx (current metrics), capacity-request-template.docx

Thanks — short replies or ✅ reactions are fine.

—Naomi Feldman
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter trajectory: scope trims, critical dependencies, and QBR deck asks

Naomi —

Agree with the narrow re-scope. I’ll own the capacity ask and perf bench. Rohan, please take the runbook & capacity-request-template and run a 48-hour baseline against staging + a 2-hour peak soak. Deliverables: perf report (p95,p99,token/sec) and recommended reservation size. Target: Oct 5 for the report, Oct 7 for procurement ticket.

Also: we should note a fallback model variant for the QBR (lower-cost quantized variant) — flagging that as a cost mitigation on the slide.

— Vivek
VP, Infrastructure & Serving
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter trajectory: scope trims, critical dependencies, and QBR deck asks

Quick notes from the SLO side:
- I’ll validate the current latency SLOs against the staging perf numbers Vivek/Rohan produce. Need the perf report to: (a) confirm whether the p99 exceeds thresholds during peak; (b) derive an emergency rollback criterion.
- If p99 is > threshold, gating will be: hold Optimize rollout to 10% traffic and enable KV-prefix cache for the first 72 hours. Owner: Karthik (will coordinate with Rohan).

Question for Finance: Monica, can you confirm whether we can reallocate the search cost center this fiscal month or if we must route through a one-time exception? I’ll mark the QBR slide accordingly.

On slides: Laura — please add a single slide called "Trajectory & Mitigation" that has: current signal, re-scope bullets, top 3 risks + owners, and contingency triggers. Keep it one slide.

Regards,
Karthik
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

Monica: funding confirmation or procurement path by Oct 2 (so we can list ask in QBR).
Laura: produce the single "Trajectory & Mitigation" slide and update the Financial ask slide by Oct 1.

I’m attaching a pared-down QBR skeleton; I’ll accept short bullets in the sheet, and Laura will harmonize into slides. Please keep answers terse — one-line confirmations or ETA bullets are perfect.
